{"subject": "Checking in ahead of your next review", "body": "Dear Calloway Household,

I am writing as your adviser to check in. You have been a client since 2009, and our last meeting was Sep 22, 2026, with your next review due Sep 22, 2027. Your household holds USD 4,250,000 across 1 account, and your largest holding is the Total market ETF (VTI) at 45.7% of AUM. Cash stands at USD 129,720, or 3.1% of AUM.

Over the years you have kindly made 2 introductions, the most recent ask being Apr 18, 2025. If you know someone who might value a conversation about their finances, I would welcome an introduction. I would also be glad to set up a review to talk through your trust account at Alder Clearing, which is waiting on you.

Sincerely,
Dana Whitfield", "claims": [{"text": "You have been a client since 2009", "source_field": "client_since_year"}, {"text": "our last meeting was Sep 22, 2026", "source_field": "last_meeting_date"}, {"text": "your next review due Sep 22, 2027", "source_field": "next_review_date"}, {"text": "your largest holding is the Total market ETF (VTI) at 45.7% of AUM", "source_field": "top_holding_pct"}, {"text": "you have kindly made 2 introductions, the most recent ask being Apr 18, 2025", "source_field": "referral_count"}]}
